list.query: SELECT name AS __text, server_id AS __value FROM config.config_monitored_servers WHERE is_enabled ORDER BY name
list.description: Monitored SQL Server instance, from Darling's fleet registry.

list.name: wait_type

list.query:

FROM collect.v_wait_stats AS ws
WHERE $__timeFilter(ws.collection_time)
  AND ws.server_id IN (${server:csv})
GROUP BY ws.wait_type
ORDER BY SUM(ws.delta_wait_time_ms) DESC

FROM collect.v_wait_stats AS ws

  AND ws.server_id IN (${server:csv})
GROUP BY ws.wait_type

list.description: Wait types collected over the window, heaviest first. All plots the top 20.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT wait_type AS v
FROM collect.v_wait_stats
WHERE collection_time >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND server_id IN (${server:csv})
GROUP BY wait_type
ORDER BY SUM(delta_wait_time_ms) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(interval_seconds) > 0
    THEN SUM(delta_wait_time_ms)::double precision / SUM(interval_seconds)
    ELSE 0 END AS v
FROM (
    SELECT
        delta_wait_time_ms,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (date_trunc('second', collection_time)
            - date_trunc('second', LAG(collection_time) OVER (ORDER BY collection_time))))
            AS interval_seconds
    FROM collect.v_wait_stats
    WHERE collection_time >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND server_id IN (${server:csv})
) AS w

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(delta_waiting_requests_count), 0) AS v
FROM collect.v_latch_stats
WHERE collection_time >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND server_id IN (${server:csv})

SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(interval_seconds) > 0
    THEN SUM(delta_collisions)::double precision / SUM(interval_seconds)
    ELSE 0 END AS v
FROM (
    SELECT
        delta_collisions,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (date_trunc('second', collection_time)
            - date_trunc('second', LAG(collection_time) OVER (ORDER BY collection_time))))
            AS interval_seconds
    FROM collect.v_spinlock_stats
    WHERE collection_time >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND server_id IN (${server:csv})
) AS s

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT ws.server_id, ws.wait_type
    FROM collect.v_wait_stats AS ws
    WHERE $__timeFilter(ws.collection_time)
      AND ws.server_id IN (${server:csv})
      AND (cardinality(ARRAY[${wait_type:sqlstring}]::text[]) = 0 OR ws.wait_type = ANY(ARRAY[${wait_type:sqlstring}]::text[]))
    GROUP BY ws.server_id, ws.wait_type
    ORDER BY SUM(ws.delta_wait_time_ms) DESC
    LIMIT 20
),
windowed AS (
    SELECT
        ws.wait_type,
        ws.collection_time,
        ws.delta_wait_time_ms,
        ws.delta_signal_wait_time_ms,
        ws.delta_waiting_tasks,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (date_trunc('second', ws.collection_time)
            - date_trunc('second', LAG(ws.collection_time) OVER (
                PARTITION BY ws.server_id, ws.wait_type
                ORDER BY ws.collection_time)))) AS interval_seconds
    FROM collect.v_wait_stats AS ws
    JOIN ranked AS r
      ON r.server_id = ws.server_id
     AND r.wait_type = ws.wait_type
    WHERE $__timeFilter(ws.collection_time)
      AND ws.server_id IN (${server:csv})
)
SELECT
    collection_time AS time,
    wait_type AS metric,
    CASE
        WHEN interval_seconds > 0
        THEN delta_wait_time_ms::double precision / interval_seconds
        ELSE 0
    END AS value
FROM windowed
ORDER BY 1

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT ws.server_id, ws.wait_type
    FROM collect.v_wait_stats AS ws
    WHERE $__timeFilter(ws.collection_time)
      AND ws.server_id IN (${server:csv})
      AND (cardinality(ARRAY[${wait_type:sqlstring}]::text[]) = 0 OR ws.wait_type = ANY(ARRAY[${wait_type:sqlstring}]::text[]))
    GROUP BY ws.server_id, ws.wait_type
    ORDER BY SUM(ws.delta_wait_time_ms) DESC
    LIMIT 20
),
windowed AS (
    SELECT
        ws.wait_type,
        ws.collection_time,
        ws.delta_wait_time_ms,
        ws.delta_signal_wait_time_ms,
        ws.delta_waiting_tasks,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (date_trunc('second', ws.collection_time)
            - date_trunc('second', LAG(ws.collection_time) OVER (
                PARTITION BY ws.server_id, ws.wait_type
                ORDER BY ws.collection_time)))) AS interval_seconds
    FROM collect.v_wait_stats AS ws
    JOIN ranked AS r
      ON r.server_id = ws.server_id
     AND r.wait_type = ws.wait_type
    WHERE $__timeFilter(ws.collection_time)
      AND ws.server_id IN (${server:csv})
)
SELECT
    collection_time AS time,
    wait_type AS metric,
    CASE
        WHEN delta_waiting_tasks > 0
        THEN delta_wait_time_ms::double precision / delta_waiting_tasks
        ELSE 0
    END AS value
FROM windowed
ORDER BY 1

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT ws.server_id, ws.wait_type
    FROM collect.v_wait_stats AS ws
    WHERE $__timeFilter(ws.collection_time)
      AND ws.server_id IN (${server:csv})
      AND (cardinality(ARRAY[${wait_type:sqlstring}]::text[]) = 0 OR ws.wait_type = ANY(ARRAY[${wait_type:sqlstring}]::text[]))
    GROUP BY ws.server_id, ws.wait_type
    ORDER BY SUM(ws.delta_wait_time_ms) DESC
    LIMIT 20
),
windowed AS (
    SELECT
        ws.wait_type,
        ws.collection_time,
        ws.delta_wait_time_ms,
        ws.delta_signal_wait_time_ms,
        ws.delta_waiting_tasks,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (date_trunc('second', ws.collection_time)
            - date_trunc('second', LAG(ws.collection_time) OVER (

                ORDER BY ws.collection_time)))) AS interval_seconds
    FROM collect.v_wait_stats AS ws
    JOIN ranked AS r
      ON r.server_id = ws.server_id
     AND r.wait_type = ws.wait_type
    WHERE $__timeFilter(ws.collection_time)
      AND ws.server_id IN (${server:csv})
)
SELECT
    collection_time AS time,
    wait_type AS metric,
    CASE
        WHEN interval_seconds > 0
        THEN delta_signal_wait_time_ms::double precision / interval_seconds
        ELSE 0
    END AS value
FROM windowed
ORDER BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Query Snapshots"
FROM collect.v_query_snapshots AS qs
WHERE $__timeFilter(qs.collection_time)
  AND qs.server_id IN (${server:csv})
  AND (cardinality(ARRAY[${wait_type:sqlstring}]::text[]) = 0 OR qs.wait_type = ANY(ARRAY[${wait_type:sqlstring}]::text[]))
  AND qs.query_text NOT LIKE 'WAITFOR%'

WITH top_classes AS (
    SELECT t.server_id, t.latch_class
    FROM collect.v_latch_stats AS t
    WHERE $__timeFilter(t.collection_time)
      AND t.server_id IN (${server:csv})
    GROUP BY t.server_id, t.latch_class
    ORDER BY SUM(t.delta_wait_time_ms) DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
windowed AS (
    SELECT
        t.latch_class,
        t.collection_time,
        t.delta_wait_time_ms AS delta_value,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (date_trunc('second', t.collection_time)
            - date_trunc('second', LAG(t.collection_time) OVER (
                PARTITION BY t.server_id, t.latch_class
                ORDER BY t.collection_time)))) AS interval_seconds
    FROM collect.v_latch_stats AS t
    JOIN top_classes AS c
      ON c.server_id = t.server_id
     AND c.latch_class = t.latch_class
    WHERE $__timeFilter(t.collection_time)
      AND t.server_id IN (${server:csv})
)
SELECT
    collection_time AS time,
    latch_class AS metric,
    CASE
        WHEN interval_seconds > 0
        THEN delta_value::double precision / interval_seconds
        ELSE 0
    END AS value
FROM windowed
ORDER BY 1

WITH top_classes AS (
    SELECT t.server_id, t.spinlock_name
    FROM collect.v_spinlock_stats AS t
    WHERE $__timeFilter(t.collection_time)
      AND t.server_id IN (${server:csv})
    GROUP BY t.server_id, t.spinlock_name
    ORDER BY SUM(t.delta_collisions) DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
windowed AS (
    SELECT
        t.spinlock_name,
        t.collection_time,
        t.delta_collisions AS delta_value,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (date_trunc('second', t.collection_time)
            - date_trunc('second', LAG(t.collection_time) OVER (
                PARTITION BY t.server_id, t.spinlock_name
                ORDER BY t.collection_time)))) AS interval_seconds
    FROM collect.v_spinlock_stats AS t
    JOIN top_classes AS c
      ON c.server_id = t.server_id
     AND c.spinlock_name = t.spinlock_name
    WHERE $__timeFilter(t.collection_time)
      AND t.server_id IN (${server:csv})
)
SELECT
    collection_time AS time,
    spinlock_name AS metric,
    CASE
        WHEN interval_seconds > 0
        THEN delta_value::double precision / interval_seconds
        ELSE 0
    END AS value
FROM windowed
ORDER BY 1

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT t.server_id, MAX(t.collection_time) AS mx
    FROM collect.v_latch_stats AS t
    WHERE $__timeFilter(t.collection_time)
      AND t.server_id IN (${server:csv})
    GROUP BY t.server_id
)
SELECT
    t.latch_class AS "Latch Class",
    t.waiting_requests_count AS "Waiting Requests",
    t.wait_time_ms AS "Wait Time (ms)",
    t.max_wait_time_ms AS "Max Wait Time (ms)",
    t.delta_waiting_requests_count AS "Waiting Requests (delta)",
    t.delta_wait_time_ms AS "Wait Time (delta ms)"
FROM latest AS l
JOIN collect.v_latch_stats AS t
  ON t.server_id = l.server_id
 AND t.collection_time = l.mx
ORDER BY t.delta_wait_time_ms DESC, t.wait_time_ms DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT t.server_id, MAX(t.collection_time) AS mx
    FROM collect.v_spinlock_stats AS t
    WHERE $__timeFilter(t.collection_time)
      AND t.server_id IN (${server:csv})
    GROUP BY t.server_id
)
SELECT
    t.spinlock_name AS "Spinlock",
    t.collisions AS "Collisions",
    t.spins AS "Spins",
    t.spins_per_collision AS "Spins per Collision",
    t.sleep_time AS "Sleep Time",
    t.backoffs AS "Backoffs",
    t.delta_collisions AS "Collisions (delta)",
    t.delta_spins AS "Spins (delta)"
FROM latest AS l
JOIN collect.v_spinlock_stats AS t
  ON t.server_id = l.server_id
 AND t.collection_time = l.mx
ORDER BY t.delta_collisions DESC, t.collisions DESC
LIMIT 20
